name: TvlComparisonBar
texts: Vesting TVL by protocol$1.47Bacross 4 protocolsEvery number here is vesting-specific TVL – no LP locks, no launchpad escrows, no staking. Two methodologies, depending on the protocol:via DefiLlama – for Sablier, Hedgey, and Streamflow, we use DefiLlama's chainTvls.vesting aggregate, which they already report as a vesting-only slice.Self-indexed – for every other protocol, we walk the protocol's data source exhaustively (subgraph, contract events, or Solana program accounts), sum the remaining locked token amounts, and price each token via DexScreener with CoinGecko as fallback. Tokens with ≥$10k DEX liquidity are high confidence, $1k–$10k medium, $100–$1k thin. All three bands count toward the headline. To defend against pricing outliers, single-token contributions are capped per band: $200M (high), $10M (medium), $500K (thin). Tokens with under $100 DEX liquidity are skipped entirely.Last verified 6h ago.
